about_short_description.short_description: Spherecast is Software Development firm supporting multi channel E commerce businesses by Solving out of stock and overstock problems.

product.name: Multi-Warehouse Inventory Optimization
product.description: Provides replenishment recommendations for multiple warehouses to maintain ideal stock levels and avoid stockouts or overstock.

product.name: Omni-Channel Demand Planning
product.description: Supports forecasting for each SKU and sales channel using various methods and allows switching between top-down and bottom-up planning.

product.name: Automated Replenishment
product.description: Automates replenishment by processing emails, PDFs, and matching shipment and purchase orders with replenishment decisions, updating ETAs automatically.

product.name: Inventory Health
product.description: Provides real-time metrics and KPIs on inventory and supply chain status, including availability, stock value, forecast accuracy, and coverage.
